 222:     """
 223:     Differential Flatness FOC Controller for NANOTEC DB42S02.
 224: 
 225:     Architecture
 226:     ------------
 227:     SpeedFusion : complementary filter blending encoder IIR and SMO estimates.
 228:     SMO         : Sliding Mode Observer for back-EMF / electrical speed.
 229:     EKF         : Extended Kalman Filter (optional, enabled via set_observer_mode)
 230:     Voltage law : flatness feedforward with id/iq proportional correction terms.
 231: 
 232:     Observer Modes
 233:     --------------
 234:     - SMO (0)   : Sliding Mode Observer only (default, matches original production)
 235:     - EKF (1)   : Extended Kalman Filter only (smoother estimate, higher CPU cost)
 236:     - BLEND (2) : Convex blend: omega = (1-w)*SMO + w*EKF
 237: 
 238:     Parameters
 239:     ----------
 240:     v_dc : float
 241:         DC bus voltage [V].  Default 17.0.
 242:     p_poles : int
 243:         Pole pairs.  Default 4.
 244:     R_s : float
 245:         Stator resistance [Ohm].  Default 0.285.
 246:     L_d : float
 247:         d-axis inductance [H].  Default 3.675e-4.
 248:     L_q : float
 249:         q-axis inductance [H].  Default 3.675e-4.
 250:     lambda_pm : float
 251:         Permanent magnet flux linkage [Wb].  Default 0.0014.
 252:     i_max : float
 253:         Maximum phase current [A].  Default 3.57.
 254:     dt_s : float
 255:         Nominal sampling time [s].  Default 50e-6 (20 kHz).
 256:     kp_speed : float
 257:         Speed P-gain [A/(rad/s)].  Default 0.4.
 258:     kp_id : float
 259:         D-axis current P-gain [V/A].  Default 0.4.
 260:     kp_iq : float
 261:         Q-axis current P-gain [V/A].  Default 8.0.
 262: 
 263:     Notes
 264:     -----
 265:     Motor parameters and gains are compile-time constants in the C headers.
 266:     Constructor arguments are for API documentation; edit the #defines and
 267:     recompile to change them.
 268: 
 269:     Attributes (readonly)
 270:     ---------------------
 271:     v_alpha : float          Alpha-axis voltage reference [V].
 272:     v_beta : float           Beta-axis voltage reference [V].
 273:     speed_est : float        Speed estimate [rad/s] (depends on observer mode).
 274:     iq_ref : float           q-axis current reference [A].
 275:     fusion_alpha : float     SpeedFusion weight (0 = encoder, 1 = SMO).
 276:     omega_e : float          Fused electrical speed [rad/s].
 277:     omega_smo : float        SMO mechanical speed estimate [rad/s].
 278:     omega_ekf : float        EKF mechanical speed estimate [rad/s].
 279:     obs_mode : int           Current observer mode (0=SMO, 1=EKF, 2=BLEND).
 280:     status : int             0 = success.
 281: 
 282:     Examples
 283:     --------
 284:     >>> ctrl = DFCControllerWrapper()
 285:     >>> ctrl.set_inputs_individual(209.4, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
 286:     >>> ctrl.compute(50e-6)
 287:     >>> v_alpha, v_beta = ctrl.get_outputs()
 288:     >>> ctrl.set_observer_mode(1)  # Switch to EKF mode
 289:     """
